note: The tag evidence decides it. In '#%' cells n1 equals the tagged interest_rate on 12407 of 12409 compared rows. In '#% (#% PIK)' cells n1 equals the total interest_rate and n2 equals pik_rate. In '#% PIK' cells n1 equals the tagged pik_rate on 1495 of 1496 rows. A few of those rows (32) carry an interest_rate tag that matches n1, so a pure-PIK coupon is occasionally tagged as the all-in rate, but pik_rate is the better fit. The spread is in its own column.
